page.overview:
What is Lanvorak?

A lanvorak was a weapon after which Lanvorak Squad was named.

A lanvorak, albeit unnamed, first appeared in the current Star Wars canon in the fifth issue of the comic series Star Wars Adventures: Tales from Vader's Castle, written by Cavan Scott and illustrated by Derek Charm and Chris Fenoglio. The issue was released by IDW Publishing It was first identified as such in the 2019 reference book Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary, written by Pablo Hidalgo. and published on January 10, 1995.

Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary
